attacker_pocs.name: mixed_planar_rgb_depth
attacker_pocs.why: The public decode API converts a valid uncompressed planar RGB image with 16-bit R/G and 8-bit B to identity-matrix YCbCr. The shipped depth check accepts it because G matches R, so the conversion reads B as 16-bit pixels beyond its 8-bit plane allocation. The upstream fix rejects either mismatched channel before conversion.

role_a_rationale: The commit corrects the identity-matrix source and destination strides and adds a planar RGB depth check, matching the shape of the upstream maintenance fix. Its conjunction checks only the case where both G and B differ from R; the upstream disjunction rejects either mismatch. A single mismatched B plane therefore remains unsafe under the public decode API.
